parsed.g: Find and report the number of reviews that the store has received that mention the term 'decent'
P_t: Navigated to Marketing section by clicking the MARKETING link
Navigated to All Reviews page under Marketing > User Content > All Reviews
Located the Review filter textbox on the Reviews page
R_t: Clear the corrupted text 'satisfdecentdecentdecentdecentied' from the Review filter textbox
Type only 'decent' into the Review filter textbox
Click the Search button to apply the filter
Read and report the number of records found
parsed.e_t: The ground-truth DOM shows the admin session has expired and the page has been redirected to the Magento Admin login page (adminhtml-auth-login). The page displays a login form with username and password fields, not the Reviews admin page. The agent's observations show the Reviews page, but the actual DOM is the login page, indicating a session timeout occurred.
C: The admin session has expired per the ground-truth DOM — the agent must re-authenticate before any admin actions can be performed
The Review filter textbox contains corrupted text that must be fully cleared before typing 'decent'
Only the exact term 'decent' should be entered in the Review filter, not any concatenated or corrupted version

F_t.action: Typed 'decent' into Review filter textbox [2253] without clearing prior content
F_t.cause: The type action appended 'decent' to existing text in the field, resulting in corrupted search term 'satisfdecentied' as seen in subsequent observations

F_t.action: Clicked Search button [2135] to apply filter
F_t.cause: Search was performed with corrupted text 'satisfdecentied' instead of just 'decent', returning 0 records found

F_t.action: Typed 'decent' into Review filter textbox [4076] with clear=True
F_t.cause: Despite clear=True flag, the text continued to accumulate, resulting in 'satisfdecentdecentied' in subsequent step, suggesting the clear operation did not work as expected

F_t.action: Typed 'decent' into Review filter textbox [5279] with clear=True
F_t.cause: Text continued to accumulate to 'satisfdecentdecentdecentied', clear operation still ineffective

F_t.action: Typed 'decent' into Review filter textbox [6482] with clear=False
F_t.cause: Without clearing, text further accumulated to 'satisfdecentdecentdecentied', search returned 0 records

F_t.action: Pressed Ctrl+a to select all text in the Review filter textbox
F_t.cause: The Ctrl+a action did not clear the field; the corrupted text 'satisfdecentdecentdecentdecentied' remained in the gridcell per the observation DOM

F_t.action: Typed 'decent' into Review filter textbox [6482] with clear=False after Ctrl+a
F_t.cause: Per ground-truth DOM, the admin session had expired and the page redirected to the login page, making this action ineffective on the Reviews page

K_t: The Magento Admin Reviews page is accessible via Marketing > User Content > All Reviews
The Review filter textbox on the Reviews page allows filtering reviews by content text
The agent's session has expired per the ground-truth DOM which shows the login page instead of the Reviews page
All previous search attempts returned 0 records due to corrupted filter text, not because there are no reviews with 'decent'
The correct filter text should be exactly 'decent' with no other characters
The clear=True parameter in type actions did not reliably clear the existing field content in this trajectory
The ground-truth DOM at step 9 is the login page (adminhtml-auth-login class on body), not the Reviews page
